implementation_interpretations.item: Reduced analytic setups (AL-01..AL-04, AL-07..AL-09, AL-11, IV-02) run with topology_scope ANALYTIC_REDUCED_NETWORK, allowed only in SYNTHETIC_VERIFICATION. Every PARAMETRIC / BENCH_REPLICA / FLIGHT_CONDITIONAL case uses NP_THERMAL_NETWORK, where every REQUIRED node is enforced (nodes.rule). The prereg registers the reduced setups and the REQUIRED-node rule side by side; this scope keeps both.
The value_record status vocabulary has no TBD; the 'key status TBD' of AL-10 / IFH-1 is the producer status INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (on_failure 'INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (TBD)').

A-15 allows a temperature-dependent contact conductance but registers no evaluation temperature for h_c; v1 accepts only a temperature-independent h_c record (with its validity range checked at both link ends); a temperature-dependent form is refused (MODEL_ERROR). A v2 rule is needed before one is registered.

Step doubling (NUM-04): the accepted state is the full step T_dt; two half steps give the CONS-T2 estimate u_num,t = max |T_dt - T_dt/2|; a rejected step halves the step for the rest of its nominal interval; at most 20 successive halvings.

D-01 without extrapolation: Newton iterates stay inside each node's intersection of property ranges; a Newton direction blocked at a range end returns OUT_OF_DOMAIN with the node, record, bound and value (the AL-11 runaway mechanism). It is conservative: no temperature is ever emitted from outside a range.
Transient and periodic runs report the heat-flow outputs (O-07..O-13) at the final accepted state (heat_flows_at_t_s); temperatures at every accepted step (O-04).

Case and output schemas (abep_np_thermal_case_v1 / abep_np_thermal_output_v1), the record quantity vocabulary and unit spellings (W/K, m^2, J/(kg*K), ...) are implementation choices; the prereg fixes no spelling.
O-16 internal-gradient estimate Q_i L_c / (k A): Q_i is the node throughput, half the sum of the magnitudes of its heat terms.
D-02 h_eff link term: dQ/dT_i of each link (G, h_c A_c, or S k(T_i) for a Kirchhoff link) plus 4 eps sigma T^3 A per surface; Biot is the maximum over the evaluated states.
D-05 bench supply modes: only the names D-05 gives (BENCH_AR_ENGINEERING_GROUND_ONLY, N2) plus NON_FIRING; further bench gases need registration.

GovernedContext reads the credible Hall set, screening candidates, HallThruster.jl pin, design states, flight configuration, P4 candidate ids and bus variants from sha256-verified records. NP-ICP admission and the host thermal ICD have no record yet and are held empty / absent in code; admitting either needs a code and test change.
Flight cases raise CREDIBLE_HALL_TRANSPORT_SET_EMPTY whenever a Hall discharge key is not measured while the set is empty (FT-01), independently of how the producer marks the key.
ORBIT_AVERAGE_STEADY averages loads only (E-12): products of held series are integrated exactly; time-varying fixed temperatures or coil reference values are refused (MODEL_ERROR).

Sinks (SPACE, B_FACILITY) carry no view-factor row (no registered area); D-07 checks every non-sink row's summation and reciprocity between non-sink members; radiation to a sink is A_k F_ks (J_k - J_s).
Structural checks (floating node, enclosure membership, environment surfaces) use the registered structure, so a TBD record yields INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE without cascading structural MODEL_ERRORs.

findings.text: NP-ICP-NEUTRALIZER prereg v1 publishes IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1 with the seven prescribed keys plus eight additional keys (P_icp_rf_reflected_W, Q_icp_line_W, P_icp_abs_W, P_icp_collector_bias_W, Q_icp_bias_collector_W, Q_icp_bias_export_W, Q_icp_outflow_upstream_W, Q_icp_outflow_downstream_W) and an induced Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W share to N_MOUNT. This consumer implements the thermal prereg: exactly IK-01..IK-07, IK-02 shares to N_COLLECTOR / N_HOUSING only, and an unknown key is MODEL_ERROR (INTERFACE_KEY_NOT_REGISTERED; 'never a silent remap'). The two records share the label IF-ICP-THERMAL-v1 with different key sets; integration needs IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 on both sides (CC-02; OQ-NPT-02, CF-04).

CONS-L1 cannot be evaluated inside the thermal model (its text assigns it to the SC-WP-05 system energy-ledger check). Whether ADM-03 'every CONS criterion' requires that system check before VERIFIED is an owner question (Q-02).

D-07 accepts reciprocity errors up to 1e-9 relative, while CONS-S2 (1e-9 Q_scale + 1e-9 W) counts internal radiative exchange only through its reciprocity defect. A view-factor set at the D-07 limit with large internal exchange could therefore miss CONS-S2 and end MODEL_ERROR (fail-closed). Registered view factors built with exact reciprocity (VS-NET, the analytic cases) are unaffected.

AL-06 presumes that tau_max (largest node C_i / G_i,lin) bounds the slowest relaxation of the network. A first VS-NET draft violated this (collective mode ~2.6e3 s vs tau_max 217 s; 0.50 K left at 30 tau_max); VS-NET was redesigned before registration (heavy, weakly coupled R_HALL). Recorded in vs_net_registration_v1.json.
